tools.name: recent_deployments
tools.description: The newest rows to enter The Deploy Log, newest first. Optionally one lane or one company. Each row names what shipped, when, and the publisher's own source URL.

tools.name: deployments_in_week
tools.description: Every row of The Deploy Log that shipped in one ISO week, the same rows as its week page. Each row carries the publisher's own source URL.

tools.name: search_deployments
tools.description: Rows of The Deploy Log whose company, subject or what shipped contains the words given, newest first. Each row carries the publisher's own source URL.
